newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD sees AT&T entry into Japan having small impact.
newsitem.headline: KDD sees AT&T entry into Japan having small impact.

text.p: Japan's biggest international carrier Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) said on Tuesday that AT&T Corp's entry into Japan's international call market would have little impact on KDD's business.
"As far as corporate customers are concerned, there will be little difference in call tariffs offered by KDD and AT&T," said a KDD spokesman.

Japanese media reports that AT&T will launch a call-back service in Japan, offering Japanese corporate customers international call services at rates substantially lower than KDD's, depressed KDD shares on Tuesday.
